summary: Lane 2 recon complete (worktree C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/smartcompare-kpi @ 7af40eb, read-only). Inventoried all ~35 axis extractors/discriminators in app/services/price_service.py with anchors, mapped the 8 decision sites they feed (is_exact_match / _selection_match / _backstop_identity_ok / select_best / should_cache_price / _cache_price_identity_ok / is_price_showable / eval KPI), and classified the residual leak classes by WHICH site leaks (selection vs backstop-only vs over-rejection). Key structural facts for the VariantDescriptor: (1) every axis already exists as a pure extractor + a per-axis mismatch predicate — option C is genuinely a formalization, not new parsing; (2) the same strings are re-parsed up to ~5x per candidate across strict_title_match/_axis_mismatch/_selection_match/variant_precision_rank/should_cache_price — extract-once is a real win; (3) all decision functions already no-op when ENABLE_EXACT_PRICE_GATE is off, so the Phase-A refactor inherits flag-OFF byte-identity FOR FREE; (4) the house pattern for new behaviour is a sibling flag that HARD-REQUIRES the exact gate (adapter_selection_primary_enabled precedent, price_service.py:5027); (5) the ~9 residuals split into 3 closure modes: backstop-only (Sauvage→Elixir, AirPods Pro→Pro 2 — bounded token axes suffice, no LLM), both-sites-deliberate-tradeoff (gender flanker / one-sided SPF / makeup formula — token-impossible, needs curated-reference + narrow LLM hint), and over-rejections (ZMA/Cal-Mag acronym, Omega-3 hyphen — deterministic alias folds, no LLM). Recommended: LLM hint fires ONLY at cache-write time in off-clock/warm contexts (never the 15s live path; live display keeps the HELD tolerances), curated reference first, gpt-4o-mini temp=0 JSON, Redis-cached verdicts 90d, per-run cap knob, fail-closed = refuse-the-cache-write (price still displays). Migration: Phase A refactor-with-pins (no new flag, golden-corpus equivalence dump) → Phase B1 backstop new axes (the warmer precondition) → Phase B2 selection recoveries → Phase B3 LLM hint, each behind coverage sweeps both directions.

findings.topic: The residual classes classified by WHICH site leaks (defines per-mode closure targets)
findings.detail: CLASS A — BACKSTOP-ONLY leaks (selection already rejects via superset; the axis-only _backstop_identity_ok at cache-read + display cannot see an identity-token ADD): (A1) same-token concentration flanker 'Sauvage→Sauvage Elixir' — xfail pin test_correctness_coverage_sweep_fixes.py:196-204; item-6b design HELD: symmetric set-equality axis over ONLY unambiguous flanker words {elixir, supreme, absolu, intense, extreme}, NEVER base-name words (private/oud/noir/nuit — 'Tom Ford Private Blend Oud Wood' IS 'Oud Wood'); (A2) AirPods Pro→Pro 2 (bare generation int is identity, not an axis — invisible to _axis_mismatch). These are closable with BOUNDED deterministic token axes (the _category_type_added shape), NO LLM. CLASS B — BOTH-SITES deliberate tradeoffs (token-IMPOSSIBLE, pinned HELD; need curated-reference + narrow LLM hint): (B1) gender flanker base→femme ('Sauvage→Pour Femme', 'Eros→Eros Pour Femme') — HELD pins :159-162; leaks through _selection_match TOO (gender stripped from identity + padding); symmetrizing mass-over-rejects women's-base fragrances (Black Opium→'For Women' is the SAME product); (B2) one-sided SPF add (Kiehl's→SPF 30) — HELD :165-172; an SPF-add fail-close with sunscreen carve-out was IMPLEMENTED AND REVERTED (unbounded sunscreen-name set: Vichy Capital Soleil/Photoderm/Banana Boat over-rejected); (B3) makeup one-sided formula line (Fit Me→Dewy+Smooth) — HELD :175-180. CLASS C — OVER-REJECTIONS of CORRECT products (deterministic alias folds, no LLM): (C1) supplement acronyms ZMA/Cal-Mag — xfail :255-260 (acronym is not a subset of its expansion; fails selection superset both ways); (C2) hyphen-vs-space Omega-3≠'Omega 3' (normalize_words glues 'omega3' vs {'omega','3'}); (C3) apparel bare size-letter ambiguity (minor, defer). CLASS D — typed-unit: cross-unit g↔ml fail-closed PEND (pin :207-210) — CORRECT behaviour, keep; a density-1 tolerance only with a curated liquid-category list, defer. CLASS E — ReDoS 512-cap truncation xfail :216-222 (near-zero reachability, keep). LADDER AMPLIFIER: ENABLE_ADAPTER_QUERY_LADDER (ON) strips exactly the gender/concentration axes at RETRIEVAL, so stores carrying only the flanker now SURFACE it (plan doc §F1 note) — closing Class A+B acceptance neutralizes the exposure; this is the stated warmer-activation precondition alongside the backstop residuals.

findings.topic: Hard constraints + house precedents the design must honor
findings.detail: (1) FLAG-OFF BYTE-IDENTITY IS FREE for a refactor: every decision function early-returns no-op when exact_gate_enabled() is False (is_exact_match :5387, _selection_match :5634, should_cache_price :6151, select_best :5930 legacy-cheapest, is_price_showable backstop :1375, _cache_price_identity_ok scs:733, _brand_evidence_ok :5135) — a descriptor living entirely behind the existing gate inherits the rollback. (2) NEW-BEHAVIOUR flag precedent: adapter_selection_primary_enabled :5027 HARD-REQUIRES exact_gate_enabled() (returns False when gate off) — the exact sibling-flag pattern for Wave-2 axes/hints. (3) The display/cache-read backstop must NEVER run the full superset — tried and CONFIRMED over-rejecting (is_price_showable comment :1408-1420: converted_usd/page-scrape/iHerb paths reach display WITHOUT _selection_match having run, and their descriptive PDP titles carry extra tokens); only BOUNDED add-checks (_category_type_added shape) are backstop-safe. (4) The identity stamp must use the LISTING's real name, never the query (plan doc gotcha — self-match defeats the gate). (5) The 15s live path budget: genuine tiers already starve under _PRICE_RACE_TIMEOUT (determinism item 1, ENABLE_GENUINE_PRICE_PRIORITY dormant) — NO network/LLM call may join the live match path; even an extra Redis read per candidate is suspect. (6) Warm contexts exist and are env-distinguished: cron_warm_price_cache.py sets WARMER_* envs (PRICE_RACE_TIMEOUT=60 etc. :49-58); scripts/warm_kpi_truth.py + measure_warmed_kpi.py are the KPI warm/measure pair; per-run budget-cap precedent = WARMER_MAX_SERPER_CREDITS_PER_RUN (tier-independent). (7) gpt-4o-mini JSON-mode call shape + per-call cost tracking precedent in openai_service.py (:190-236, response_format json_object, ~$0.0001-0.0002/small call). (8) Adapters ALREADY stamp structured fields on price dicts: brand (algolia :529, magento :745, noon :205/:465), structured_code (algolia :532 ONLY), size (jsonld :7132, zyte :666), name (jsonld :7234/:7293); occ threads manufacturer as candidate_brand (occ_service.py:138) but does NOT stamp price['brand'] — a Wave-2 stamp gap; woo/salla/rest_json/unbxd stamp no brand. (10) Pin battery to preserve: ~827-pin session-3 battery, test_correctness_coverage_sweep_fixes.py (14 pass + 3 STRICT xfail — closing a residual FLIPS a strict xfail to XPASS=failure, so each closure must deliberately EDIT the pin), test_kpi_session_fixes.py (12), Ahmed's test_correctness_review_pr9_fixes.py, test_electronics_unlock_bfix.py, test_fashion_skincare_unlock_bfix.py, eval-contract parity pins; comm gate vs .qa-correctness/main-baseline-failed.txt (46 lines). recommendations.detail: PLACEMENT: define inside price_service.py (a clearly-fenced '=== VARIANT DESCRIPTOR ===' section) — every primitive it formalizes is module-local, so no import churn and no circular-import risk (a separate module would need lazy imports BOTH ways; price_service already uses lazy imports only outward to source_router). Re-export for adapters + eval. SHAPE: a frozen dataclass extracted ONCE per side: VariantDescriptor{ identity_core: frozenset[str] (from _identity_tokens_ps minus padding — computed with brand+category), brand_tokens: frozenset[str] (alias-expanded via _BRAND_ALIAS_GROUPS), structured_code: str, model_codes: frozenset (Luxottica family), concentration: Optional[str], flanker_markers: frozenset (NEW), size: Optional[(value, unit_class∈{ml,g,gb,ct})] (typed — cross-class comparison stays fail-closed), storage_gb/ram_gb, count, doses: frozenset[(val,unit)], bare_doses, percents, spfs, packs, shoe_sizes, clothing_sizes, inches, chip_tiers, core_counts: (cpu,gpu,unlabeled), qualifiers, plus_stems, gender: Optional['men'|'women'], form: Optional[str], flavours, finishes, materials, fits, preps, vitamin_letters, supplement_types, supplement_alt_forms, colors, year_annotations, condition: bool, generation_ints: frozenset (NEW, bounded), provenance: dict[field→'structured'|'title'|'query'] }. Every field None/empty = UNKNOWN — the tri-state (MATCH/MISMATCH/UNKNOWN per axis) is the genuinely new capability; today's booleans conflate 'no signal' with 'match', which is exactly where the LLM hint keys in. EXTRACTION ORDER (candidate side, price dict input): (1) STRUCTURED-FIRST — stamp from retailer fields where present: brand (algolia/magento/noon already stamp; ADD the occ manufacturer stamp at occ_service.py:138→price['brand'], and audit woo/salla/rest_json for available brand fields), structured_code (algolia :532), size (price['size']), in_stock, retailer/seller; a structured value WINS over the title parse for that axis and marks provenance='structured'. (2) TITLE PARSE — run the EXISTING regex extractors verbatim (each field anchored to its current function; zero new parsing in Phase A), input capped at _MATCH_INPUT_CAP. (3) QUERY side: same extractor over (brand + name), category threaded (param or the :973 ContextVar). MEMOIZE with a bounded lru_cache keyed (text, brand, category) — pure function, kills the ~5x re-parse per candidate across strict/axis/selection/precision/cache-write/display.

recommendations.topic: descriptor_verdict: ONE decision function with 3 modes, replacing the scattered checks as a REFACTOR-WITH-PINS
recommendations.detail: descriptor_verdict(q: VD, c: VD, category, mode) → Verdict{MATCH | MISMATCH(axis, detail) | UNKNOWN(axes)} with a per-field comparator table encoding TODAY'S semantics exactly: EXACT_BOTH_STATED (one-sided tolerated): concentration, size(same unit-class), storage, count, dose(same-unit), weight/volume(same-base headline-max), percent, spf, ram, inch, chip-tier, core-counts(label-aware), flavour(supplements), finish, material, fit, prep, vitamin-letter, shoe-size, pack, clothing-size, bare-dose, gender-contradiction. SET_EQUALITY: electronics qualifiers, plus_stems, both-unlabeled core-counts. ASYMMETRIC_ADD (candidate-adds rejects): flagship-concentration, supplement type/alt-form, grocery flavour, colors(query-subset), NEW flanker_markers. EITHER_SIDED: condition. QUERY_STATED_REQUIRES_CANDIDATE (fail-closed omission): the _candidate_missing_query_axis:4073 set. CROSS_CLASS_FAIL_CLOSED: weight-vs-volume disjoint bases. Plus the mode-scoped tolerances (year-annotation, 'ai', construction-bigram, eyewear-code-confirmed, inch-equality, makeup shade-number, structured-code override). MODES: SELECTION (current _selection_match contract: axes + subset + superset + padding + tolerances + 'other' re-inference), EXACT (current is_exact_match: axes + identity set-equality), BACKSTOP (current axis-only + _category_type_added + the NEW bounded fields — never the superset, per the :1408-1420 proof). _axis_mismatch/_selection_match/is_exact_match/_backstop_identity_ok become thin wrappers over extract+verdict; their signatures and every caller stay untouched. strict_title_match, numbers_match, variant_precision_rank, _brand_evidence_ok stay as-is (pre-gates/tiebreaks, not axis logic). NEW FIELDS CLOSING RESIDUALS: (a) flanker_markers — symmetric set-equality over ONLY {elixir, supreme, absolu, intense, extreme} (+ diacritic folds; NEVER private/oud/noir/nuit/sport), enforced in BACKSTOP mode too → closes Sauvage→Elixir at cache-read+display (Class A1); land behind the mandated big both-directions sweep. (b) generation_ints at BACKSTOP — candidate adds a bare 1-digit int (1-4) absent from the query when the query carries the same model family → closes AirPods Pro→Pro 2 (Class A2); HIGH over-rejection risk (descriptive titles add digits) → sweep-gated, ship only if the sweep is clean, else keep as a cache-write-only check. (c) acronym fold — a curated table {zma↔{zinc,magnesium,aspartate}, calmag/cal-mag↔{calcium,magnesium}} applied as an alias in _identity_tokens_ps (the _BRAND_ALIAS_GROUPS pattern) → fixes the ZMA over-rejection (Class C1; flips the strict xfail :255 — edit the pin deliberately). (d) supplement-scope glue omega\s+(\d)→omega\1 in _fold_identity → fixes Omega-3 vs 'Omega 3' (Class C2); do NOT generalize to alpha-hyphen-digit splitting (would break WH-1000XM5-style glued tokens — verified both spellings currently collapse equal via hyphen-REMOVAL).

recommendations.topic: The NARROW LLM hint: cache-write-time only, curated-reference-first, fail-closed = refuse-the-write
recommendations.detail: SCOPE — fires iff ALL of: (1) OFF-CLOCK context only (warmer cron_warm_price_cache.py / warm_kpi_truth.py / seed scripts / measure_warmed_kpi.py) — NEVER the 15s live path; gate on an explicit argument only warm scripts pass (allow_llm_hint=True) PLUS a WARMER_CONTEXT env the cron sets, belt-and-braces (an env alone can leak into a dev server); (2) the descriptor verdict is UNKNOWN on exactly a Class-B axis the write decision needs: is_gendered_flanker (B1), inherent_spf_line (B2), makeup_formula_line (B3); (3) the CURATED REFERENCE missed. CURATED REFERENCE FIRST ($0, deterministic): data/variant_hint_reference.json — known flanker families (eros:{pour femme: DISTINCT}, black opium:{for women: SAME}, sauvage:{elixir,parfum: DISTINCT}...), inherent-SPF sunscreen lines (anthelios, photoderm, capital soleil, eltamd, supergoop, ultra sheer, banana boat...), makeup formula lines (fit me: {dewy+smooth vs matte+poreless: DISTINCT}); precedent = the bh_gcc_sources.json committed-data pattern. MODEL: gpt-4o-mini, temperature=0, response_format json_object (openai_service.py house shape). PROMPT: system='Product-catalog disambiguator. STRICT JSON only.'; user carries {category, query, candidate_title, axis, question:'is the candidate a DISTINCT product line from the query (different SKU/price), or the same product with a descriptive suffix?'}; response {distinct_product: true|false|'unknown', confidence:'high'|'low'}. Only high-confidence answers act: distinct+high → MISMATCH (refuse the cache write); same+high → MATCH; else UNKNOWN. VERDICT CACHE: Redis varhint:<sha12(normalized family, axis)> TTL 90d (product-line facts are stable) + append newly-resolved verdicts to the committed JSON periodically so the LLM converges to zero calls. FAIL-CLOSED DEFAULT (hint unavailable / low confidence / flag off): CACHE-WRITE → REFUSE (never write an unverified identity to the shared 7d-TTL cache — the price still resolves and DISPLAYS per current HELD behaviour, so no user-facing regression; the warmer merely skips that row); DISPLAY/LIVE → completely unchanged (the HELD tolerances stand — pending unknowns live would mass-over-reject sunscreens, the proven revert). This placement is justified by harm asymmetry: the residuals' durable damage is a wrong price under the genuine TTL served to everyone (the original cache-poisoning class); a one-shot tolerated display leak is the already-pinned accepted trade. COST BOUND: per-run cap knob VARHINT_MAX_CALLS_PER_RUN (default ~40, mirroring WARMER_MAX_SERPER_CREDITS_PER_RUN); ~300-in/50-out tokens ≈ $0.0001-0.0002/call → ≤ ~$0.008/warm run worst case, ~zero steady-state after the verdict cache fills. Unit tests mock the client; never live LLM in the free suite.

recommendations.topic: Flag strategy: no new flag for the refactor; two exact-gate-scoped sibling flags for new behaviour
recommendations.detail: PHASE A (formalization refactor): NO new flag. Every function the descriptor replaces already no-ops when ENABLE_EXACT_PRICE_GATE is off (F5.1) — the descriptor path lives entirely inside the gate, so flag-OFF byte-identity is inherited exactly as PR#9's keystone-v2 was. A dedicated refactor flag would force keeping BOTH implementations alive (drift risk) for no rollback value the existing gate doesn't already provide. Verify with the existing golden flag-OFF compare pattern. PHASE B (new behaviour): two sibling flags, BOTH hard-requiring exact_gate_enabled() (the adapter_selection_primary_enabled :5027 precedent — returns False when the gate is off, so rollback state never gains the new axes): (1) ENABLE_VARIANT_DESCRIPTOR_AXES (default OFF → byte-identical) gating the deterministic new fields (flanker_markers everywhere incl. backstops, generation_ints, acronym fold, omega glue); flip ON after the coverage sweeps + one KPI re-measure ×3, then it becomes a warmer-activation precondition checkbox. (2) ENABLE_VARIANT_LLM_HINT (default OFF) gating hint lookup + LLM call machinery (curated-reference reads can ride flag 1 — they are deterministic). Read-fresh-per-call env parsing with the exact_gate polarity (the :5017/:5027 idiom) so Railway flips need no redeploy. Document both in CLAUDE.md's flags section as PR-branch-only until shipped.

recommendations.topic: Migration order: refactor-all-sites-at-once → backstops → selection → hint
recommendations.detail: STEP 0 (before ANY code change): dump a GOLDEN EQUIVALENCE CORPUS — replay the coverage-sweep product×axis enumeration (the .qa-correctness/review_coverage.mjs space + the ~827-pin inputs) through the CURRENT _axis_mismatch/_selection_match/is_exact_match/_backstop_identity_ok/_category_type_added and commit the (inputs → verdict) JSON. STEP 1 (Phase A): implement extract_variant_descriptor + descriptor_verdict; convert _axis_mismatch's INTERNALS first (all callers inherit), then _selection_match's identity/superset steps, then is_exact_match/_backstop_identity_ok — all sites in ONE wave, because converting piecemeal leaves the descriptor and legacy paths computing the same axes divergently on one request (the drift class the refactor exists to kill). Gate: the golden corpus reproduces byte-for-byte + full pin battery + comm gate. STEP 2 (Phase B1 — the WARMER PRECONDITION leg): add the bounded new axes to BACKSTOP mode consumers — cache-read _cache_price_identity_ok (scs:720), display is_price_showable (:1421), cache-write should_cache_price — flanker_markers first (item 6b's held design, now sweep-gated), generation_ints second (drop to cache-write-only if the sweep shows display over-rejection). Backstops-first because (a) they are the stated warmer-activation precondition, (b) bounded add-checks are the proven-safe backstop shape, (c) smallest over-rejection surface. STEP 3 (Phase B2): selection-side residual recoveries — acronym fold + omega glue (over-rejection FIXES, so the risk direction is leaks: sweep the leak direction hard); curated-reference gendered-flanker enforcement at the CACHE-WRITE only (Eros→Pour Femme refused from cache; live display unchanged). STEP 4 (Phase B3): the LLM hint machinery for reference-missing families. After EVERY step: adversarial BOTH-DIRECTIONS coverage re-sweep through the runtime selector (the 4x-validated method — the fix's own over-rejection is the next blind spot), dispatcher gates every finding, comm gate. AFTER Wave-2 green: re-measure warmed KPI ×3 (must hold 18/18), then the warmer flip proceeds per docs/runbooks/2026-06-30-warmer-activation.md (fresh purge + this precondition + the ladder-exposure re-assessment, which Phase B1/B2 neutralizes by closing acceptance).
